svg.title: Task reuse: input cost and total CPU time
svg.desc: Task per value versus long-lived task: 798 versus 216 ns per send, about 73% lower; 280.81 versus 21.91 ms of total process CPU, about 92% lower. Medians of 15 rounds with 100,000 inputs, one thread and a 10 ms quiet period. CPU includes output and settling. Separate zero-based axes and observation windows.
